name_english: The Yoga of the Supreme Person
summary_short: Krishna explains the nature of the world, the soul, and the Supreme Reality.
summary_medium: This chapter describes the material world as a temporary tree, explains the individual soul and Supreme Soul, and reveals Krishna as the highest truth beyond the perishable and imperishable.
summary_detailed: The world compared to an inverted tree.
Detachment as the means of freedom.
what_you_learn: Why life feels unstable at times.
Who you truly are beyond roles.
What it means to live aligned.
usage_note_for_app: Chapter 15 is ideal for clarity prompts, decision support, and identity grounding.
